Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in its initial analysis of the search results. It incorrectly identified County Wexford as being in the province of Munster. County Wexford is actually located in the province of Leinster (the eastern province of Ireland), not Munster (the southern province). This geographical mistake led directly to the wrong final answer ("Munster" instead of "Leinster").
